doc.class_javadoc:
/**
 * Population of chromosomes which uses elitism (certain percentage of the best
 * chromosomes is directly copied to the next generation).
 *
 * @version $Id$
 * @since 2.0
 */
public
doc.method_javadoc:
/**
     * Creates a new ListPopulation instance and initializes its inner
     * chromosome list.
     *
     * @param populationLimit maximal size of the population
     * @param elitismRate how many best chromosomes will be directly transferred to the
     *                    next generation [in %]
     * @throws OutOfRangeException if the elitism rate is outside the [0, 1] range
     */

siblings.javadoc: /** * Start the population for the next generation. The {@link #elitismRate} * percents of the best chromosomes are directly copied to the next generation. * * @return the beginnings of the next generation. */
siblings.name: nextGeneration

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Sets the elitism rate, i.e. how many best chromosomes will be directly
     * transferred to the next generation [in %].
     *
     * @param elitismRate how many best chromosomes will be directly transferred to the
     *                    next generation [in %]
     * @throws OutOfRangeException if the elitism rate is outside the [0, 1] range
     */
siblings.name: setElitismRate

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Access the elitism rate.
     * @return the elitism rate
     */
siblings.name: getElitismRate
